title: AMD FSR SDK 2.4 Brings ML Upscaling to RX 6000 Series and Ryzen APUs
subtitle: AMD FSR™ "Redstone" SDK 2.4 brings ML-based FSR Upscaling 4.1.2 to AMD Radeon™ RX 6000 Series GPUs and select AMD Ryzen processors, adds Vulkan® support, and updates FSR Frame Generation with improved frame pacing on AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series GPUs.
